|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Rycar Ryjerd (V)]]. The image is the Players Committee card image (full card with art and lore; slip number 137 at the bottom right).
* '''Original''' ([[Rycar Ryjerd (V)]]): the Virtual Block 1 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=9 Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 9, slip 137. If your character is about to be lost from table, place all devices and Effects on that character in owner's Used Pile. Twice per game, may ▲ a device (or an Effect) that deploys on a character. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Rycar Ryjerd (V) (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013)<ref name="cl-1210_136-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142851/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 11 January 2013] (Internet Archive)</ref>: “Deploy on table. If your character is about to be lost from table, place all devices and Effects on that character in owner's Used Pile. Twice per game, may take a device (or an Effect) that deploys on a character into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' nothing: the original text, with the ▲ written out (“take … into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle”), which is notation. A repeat of an earlier text is a version of its own (wiki versions rulings, 11 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): the Players Committee card image, dated 25 February 2013 on the PC image server<ref name="srv-Virtual1-Light">Players Committee card image server, directory listing of <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/</code>, every card image dated 25 February 2013: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034541/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual1-Light/large/?C=M;O=A Internet Archive capture of 18 August 2019]. The files are byte for byte the ones still served today (research R6, 10–11 November 2026).</ref>: “Deploy on table. If your character is about to be lost from table, place all devices and Effects on that character in owner's Used Pile. Twice per game, may ▲ a device (or an Effect) that deploys on a character. (Immune to Alter.)” The server date is the date of a bulk upload of the whole folder: the image may have been made earlier, but it is placed at the date it can be shown to exist (Bill, 11 November 2026). '''What changed:''' nothing: word for word the original text. A repeat of an earlier text is a version of its own (wiki versions rulings, 11 November 2026).
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Rycar Ryjerd (V) (Errata 3)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (cover “official text as of 27 April 2013”; Light Side, p. 28)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=28, page 28. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=28 Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on table. If your character is about to be lost from table, place all devices and Effects on that character in owner's Used Pile. Twice per game, may ▲ a device (or an Effect) that deploys on a character. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' nothing: word for word the original text. A repeat of an earlier text is a version of its own (wiki versions rulings, 11 November 2026).
* '''PC-E4''' ([[Rycar Ryjerd (V) (Errata 4)]]): errata posted on the Players Committee forum on 27 March 2014, effective immediately<ref name="forum-p874174">Players Committee forum, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574, now titled “Current Rulings Archive August 2012 - December 2015”), post by Lukes Bionic Hand, 27 March 2014: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=40#p874174 p874174] (read 9–11 November 2026)</ref>: “Deploy on table. If your character is about to be lost from table, each player may place all their devices and Effects on that character in their Used Pile. Twice per game, may ▲ a device (or Effect) that deploys on a character. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' “place all devices and Effects on that character in owner's Used Pile” became “each player may place all their devices and Effects on that character in their Used Pile” (now optional, for each player, so that Our Most Desperate Hour (V) can act first); “(or an Effect)” became “(or Effect)”.
